entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems I cannot treat this as[n]a mere dream...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Course not. It's about time you[n]figured that out.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But what were those entities just now?[n]Why did they attack us?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, we did sneak in here.[n]Shouldn't be a surprise when[n]guards're comin' after us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: More importantly, what are those[n]outfits!? And... guns!? This is Japan![n]Such weaponry is illegal!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You sure are stubborn for an artist.[n]Come on, let's go back.
